content_text_body:
When going through change, the main emotion team members will feel is uncertainty - about their day-to-day, about their role, or even about their job security. The objective is to provide opportunities for team members to communicate with each other and leadership to alleviate their anxieties.

### Speak and listen openly

When announcing a change, team members will likely have lots of questions about how this change will affect them. Be open and honest with them and encourage them to be open and honest with you about their concerns. What's key here is that team members feel heard and understood.

### Create places to process uncertainty

Many of your team members may have similar questions. By creating a blog post, forum, or online group, you can more easily ensure that everyone gets answers and can move forward more effectively in the aftermath of a company change.
